verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs cover checkout integration (Paddle.js overlay/inline checkout), a Node.js SDK, sandbox testing, OpenAPI spec and Postman collection for generating clients in other languages, which together plausibly support a fast, code-first integration. However, only one language (Node.js) has an explicit first-party SDK/snippet set documented in evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that a developer can go from docs to a working payment flow in under a day. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language copy-paste code samples (e.g., Python, PHP, Ruby, mobile), and independent/hands-on verification of integration speed.
